title: Best Window Cleaning Business Apps (2026): Mobile & Offline
description: Window cleaning business apps compared: iPhone and Android apps, offline mode, on-site quotes and tap to pay in Jobber, Housecall Pro, Squeegee and more.
h1: Best window cleaning business apps for your phone
body:
Window cleaners spend the day on ladders and in driveways, not at a desk, so the phone app matters as much as the office software. This page compares the business apps window cleaning companies use on that phone-first angle: whether there's a native iPhone and Android app, what still works with no signal, and whether you can quote, invoice and take payment on site. We checked each vendor's app store listing, mobile-app pages and help docs on 2026-11-17 and list what's unknown as unknown. For the general roundup, start with our window cleaning business software guide; for recurring-visit planning see window cleaning scheduling software.

What to check in a window cleaning app

  • Native app on both platforms: if your crew mixes iPhones and Android phones, make sure the vendor publishes both. Check the minimum iOS version against older work phones.
  • Offline behavior: high-rise basements, rural routes and big commercial buildings can kill signal. Find out what you can see offline and what you can edit.
  • Quote on the spot: pane counts, stories, screens and tracks add up fast. An app that builds the quote in the driveway saves a second trip.
  • Get paid before you leave: tap to pay, saved cards or direct debit cut down on chasing invoices.
  • Crew features: clock in/out, job checklists and before/after photos on the job record.

1. Jobber: full field app with offline job forms and Tap to Pay

Jobber's mobile app page says you can quote, schedule and get paid from your phone: create and send a quote before you leave the property, turn a completed job into an invoice with a tap, send a customizable on-my-way text, text customers, fill in job forms, upload on-site photos and clock in and out so time flows into timesheets and job costing. Push notifications cover schedule changes, new booking requests, client messages and when a client views a quote. The app is available in Spanish for select team members. It's on the App Store (requires iOS 16.4 or later) and Google Play.

Offline: a March 18, 2026 product update added offline work: fill out and save job forms, review visit details and notes and track time with no internet, and everything syncs when you reconnect. Jobber's help center adds that location-based timers and reports need a connection and you may not see your team's latest updates offline.

Payments and price: the pricing page lists Tap to Pay in the Jobber app at 2.7% + 30¢ (no extra hardware), online cards at 2.9% + 30¢ and ACH at 1%. Core is $29/mo billed annually ($49/mo with no commitment) for 1 user; Connect is $99/mo billed annually; Grow is $149/mo billed annually. Extra users are $29/mo each and the trial is 14 days on Grow with no credit card. Full breakdown: Jobber pricing.

2. Housecall Pro: English and Spanish app, view-only offline mode

Housecall Pro's mobile app page lists a real-time jobs dashboard, built-in clock in/out, customer history before each appointment, estimates from templates with a built-in price book, invoices with payment links, cards on file, mobile check deposit and financing. Its FAQ says the app is on the Apple App Store and Google Play (iOS listing, requires iOS 16.0 or later; Google Play listing) and comes in English and Spanish for every role level.

Offline: the same FAQ says job and schedule data can be viewed without Wi-Fi or cell reception, but editing in offline mode is not supported. So you can see where to go and the job notes, but you can't finish the job record until you're back in signal.

Price: Basic is $59/mo billed annually ($79/mo monthly) for 1 user, Essentials $149/mo billed annually for 5 users, and MAX $299/mo billed annually for 8 users ($35/mo per extra user). On 2026-11-17 the pricing page also showed a 50%-off-for-3-months offer on monthly Essentials and MAX. Cards are from 2.59% and bank payments 1%. More: Housecall Pro pricing.

3. Squeegee: rounds app built for window cleaners, works offline

Squeegee is a UK-based scheduling, invoicing and payments platform for mobile cleaning businesses. Its Google Play listing says the app works on any phone, tablet or computer and that "whether you are offline or online it will keep your business data available." It's also on the App Store as Squeegee Work Planner (requires iOS 15.0 or later). The home page says you send an invoice with one swipe when you mark a job done, and its Day Pilot optimizes the route for each worker. Payments run through GoCardless direct debit or a Stripe card on file, with Square tap to pay listed on its payments page.

Price: per user, published in GBP only: Core £19/mo + VAT (£190/yr), Advanced £25/mo, Ultimate £33/mo, with a 30-day free trial. USD pricing isn't published (unknown). Details: Squeegee pricing.

4. ResponsiBid: on-site quoting from a phone browser

ResponsiBid is a quoting and sales tool, not a field app. Its own documentation says it isn't in the iOS App Store or Google Play and shows how to save it to your home screen instead. Its in-person quotes page says techs can quote "from any mobile device or tablet," collecting job details and turning them into a good, better, best proposal on the spot. Offline use isn't documented (unknown).

Price: the pricing page lists Startup free, Scaling $179/mo and Pro $229/mo, plus a one-time setup fee whose amount isn't published. Scheduling, invoicing and payments run through a connected CRM such as Jobber or Housecall Pro, so most window cleaners pair it with one of the apps above. Details: ResponsiBid pricing.

5. BookingKoala: provider app plus customer online booking

BookingKoala is a booking platform first. Its BookingKoala For Providers app (iOS 15.6 or later; also on Google Play) lets your cleaners view appointments, appointment checklists, job media, reviews and payments, and a provider who works for several BookingKoala companies keeps every booking under one account. The pricing page lists mobile access on Starter: manage the business from a phone, tablet or computer, customers book from any device, and providers manage their schedules on the go. Offline behavior isn't published (unknown).

Price: Starter from $27/mo (5 providers), Growing from $57/mo (15 providers, adds SMS notifications and GPS clock in/out), Premium from $197/mo. No contracts or setup fee. Card processing rates aren't published (unknown). Details: BookingKoala pricing and features. {{aff:bookingkoala|Try BookingKoala}}

Which window cleaning app fits you?

  • You work where signal drops: Squeegee says its app keeps data available offline, and Jobber now saves job forms, notes and timers offline. Housecall Pro lets you view, but not edit, jobs offline.
  • You want to get paid in the driveway: Jobber lists Tap to Pay at 2.7% + 30¢ in its app; Housecall Pro lists cards, cards on file and mobile check deposit; Squeegee lists direct debit, Stripe and Square tap to pay.
  • Bilingual crew: Housecall Pro's app is in English and Spanish for all roles; Jobber's is in Spanish for select team members.
  • UK-style rounds: Squeegee is built around rounds and per-user GBP pricing. Compare it with recurring scheduling in other tools on our window cleaning scheduling software page.
  • You quote residential homes in person: add ResponsiBid's browser-based quoting to Jobber or Housecall Pro, or use the quoting built into those apps.
  • Customers book online and cleaners just need their schedule: BookingKoala's provider app plus its booking site, from $27/mo.

Most of these apps have free trials (Jobber 14 days, Housecall Pro 14 days, Squeegee 30 days; BookingKoala's pricing FAQ says 14 days, while its pricing page header advertised a 30-day trial on 2026-11-17), so install the app on the phones your crew actually uses and test it in a spot with weak signal before you commit. faq: What is the best app for a window cleaning business?

It depends on how you work. Of the apps we checked on 2026-11-17, Jobber and Housecall Pro are full field service apps on iPhone and Android with on-site quoting and payments; Squeegee is built for recurring window cleaning rounds and says its app works offline; ResponsiBid adds browser-based quoting; BookingKoala pairs a provider app with customer online booking.
Which window cleaning apps work offline?

Squeegee's Google Play listing says it keeps business data available offline or online. Jobber's March 2026 update lets you fill out job forms, review visit details and notes and track time offline, syncing later. Housecall Pro lets you view job and schedule data offline but not edit it. ResponsiBid and BookingKoala don't publish offline behavior.
Can I take card payments on site with a window cleaning app?

Yes. Jobber lists Tap to Pay in its mobile app at 2.7% + 30 cents with no extra hardware. Housecall Pro's app lists card payments, cards on file and mobile check deposit (cards from 2.59%). Squeegee lists Stripe card on file, GoCardless direct debit and Square tap to pay.
Does ResponsiBid have a mobile app?

Not a native one. ResponsiBid's documentation says it isn't in the iOS App Store or Google Play and shows how to save the web app to your phone's home screen. Its in-person quotes page says techs can quote from any mobile device or tablet.
Is there a free window cleaning app?

ResponsiBid's Startup plan is free for quoting. Jobber, Housecall Pro, Squeegee and BookingKoala are paid after a free trial: 14 days for Jobber and Housecall Pro, 30 days for Squeegee, and 14 days for BookingKoala per its pricing FAQ (its pricing page header advertised 30 days on 2026-11-17).
